    Separated-quiver D̃₅ at a loop #

    A loop ρ at x together with two further distinct arrows out of x and two further distinct arrows into x gives a D̃₅ in the separated quiver (x⁺ → x⁻ along ρ). Made of arrows only, it cleaves into every proper residue P/τ with τ not irreducible (MildHyp.not_loop_d5).
